integrity: General two-variable rearrangement bounds are established prior work. All claimed novelty is the exact method-specific stage-amplification distribution, its sharp coupling transitions, and fixed-step exact optimum. Finite verification does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The optimal coupling is fixed-step and scalar; it may depend on r and does not automatically preserve nonlinear accuracy, multidimensional stability, or the original independent-stage assumptions. No independent validation performed.
title: Two sharp coupling transitions in randomized implicit Runge–Kutta decay
